summary: The hosts read a 1921 promotional book by Sydney B. Flower praising John R. Brinkley, the Kansas fake doctor who surgically implanted goat testicles and ovaries into patients, promising rejuvenation and cures.

evidence.note: book identified as Sydney B. Flower's goat gland guide, a Brinkley promotional work
title page dates the book to 1921, about three years after WWI
book recounts the first human goat gland operation on a farmer
Brinkley's practice placed in Milford, Kansas
book claims Brinkley is poor and refuses profit; host says he got rich
hosts link the book's sex-energy theory to modern semen-retention and manosphere ideas
book implies men's brains are superior due to testicular secretions
detailed reading of the scrotal implantation procedure
nanny goats die after ovary removal; hosts call it animal cruelty

notes: Description credits the book to Brinkley, but the transcript names Sydney B. Flower as author; Brinkley is listed as co-primary because the book is entirely about him. Flower's dates unknown, floruit 1921. Brinkley's later career (radio, governor runs, Mexico) is summarised in about two minutes, so the covered span stays on the book's 1918-1921 period.
